intent: WP-0B (TIT-001): verifier truth. Add a bounded behavioral sentinel step (overridable VERIFIER_SENTINEL, default tests/test_telos_gates.py) to make verifier-selfcheck, so the target executes real behavioral assertions instead of only syntax/F821/collection/onboarding, and narrow the success banner from ALL GATES FUNCTIONAL to an exact enumeration of what ran. Add tests/test_verifier_selfcheck_contract.py: a meta-test proving a failing sentinel makes the target exit nonzero, a positive control proving a passing sentinel yields the narrowed banner, and structural assertions that the recipe runs the sentinel behaviorally (no --collect-only), uses VENV_PYTHON, and never prints the overbroad banner.

negative_controls.name: sentinel-collection-only-detected
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import pathlib, subprocess, sys; p = pathlib.Path('Makefile'); t = p.read_text(); anchor = '-m pytest -p timeout $(VERIFIER_SENTINEL) -q --timeout=120'; (anchor in t) or sys.exit(3); p.write_text(t.replace(anchor, '-m pytest $(VERIFIER_SENTINEL) --collect-only -q --timeout=120', 1)); sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', 'tests/test_verifier_selfcheck_contract.py::TestRecipeStructure', '-q']).returncode)"

negative_controls.name: sentinel-failure-suppression-detected
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import pathlib, subprocess, sys; p = pathlib.Path('Makefile'); t = p.read_text(); anchor = 'tail -20 /tmp/dharma-sentinel-check.log; exit 1'; (anchor in t) or sys.exit(3); p.write_text(t.replace(anchor, 'tail -20 /tmp/dharma-sentinel-check.log; exit 0', 1)); sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', 'tests/test_verifier_selfcheck_contract.py::TestRecipeStructure', '-q']).returncode)"

negative_controls.name: overbroad-banner-restoration-detected
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import pathlib, subprocess, sys; p = pathlib.Path('Makefile'); t = p.read_text(); anchor = 'verifier-selfcheck: OK (syntax, F821, collection, onboarding, behavioral sentinel)'; (anchor in t) or sys.exit(3); p.write_text(t.replace(anchor, 'verifier-selfcheck: ALL GATES FUNCTIONAL', 1)); sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', 'tests/test_verifier_selfcheck_contract.py::TestRecipeStructure', '-q']).returncode)"

commit.message: feat(verify): WP-0B verifier truth via behavioral sentinel (TIT-001)

interface_mismatches: INTERFACE_MISMATCH_MAP.md carries no entry for the Makefile verifier-selfcheck surface at base 1e806bd.
honest_blockers: The meta-tests each run the full make verifier-selfcheck (test collection of the whole suite dominates, tens of seconds per run), so the contract-test gate and both jailed controls carry long timeouts; they are bounded, not fast.

Open PR #1026 (WP-0S) does not touch the Makefile, so no rebase overlap exists at packet-open time; later Wave-1 packets (WP-0C1, WP-0F1, WP-0G) do touch the Makefile and must rebase trivially against whichever lands first.

Packet pytest gates run under the runner-admitted system python3 with HOME redirected; repo dependencies are importable by system python3 via a system dist-packages editable install performed this session (PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 python3 -m pip install -e .[dev] --break-system-packages --ignore-installed cryptography), the known-host workaround from the campaign prompt.
make test-fast on this host fails only on the known tests/conformance/test_repo_ratchet_holds.py 10s-timeout flake; per-occurrence re-proof is recorded in the PR body.

Negative controls run the fast structural test class only (TestRecipeStructure): the behavioral meta-tests spawn make and git clone, which the runner's control jail (chroot, PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD, trusted-path-only executables) does not provide, and a control that fails because its environment is broken would be hollow. Each structural control was proven to flip red against its exact mutation before binding; the behavioral meta-tests run unjailed as the packet gate and in CI.
session_entry.rollback: Revert Makefile, tests/test_verifier_selfcheck_contract.py, and reports/agentops/work_packets/titanium-WP-0B-verifier-truth.json together; reverting reopens TIT-001 and blocks Phase 0. Never restore the ALL GATES FUNCTIONAL banner without a behavioral command it names.
